## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] `npm run build` passes; E2E run if the UI flow changed
- [ ] Behaviour changes are covered by tests in `tests/engine/` or `tests/server/`
- [ ] New German UI strings have at least an English translation; new engine messages have a translation pattern
- [ ] No rules text from the book or other Games Workshop publications; no new Games Workshop artwork or AI-generated images (new assets are listed in CREDITS.md with source and license)
- [ ] No secrets, player links, backups, database files or real personal data (also not in screenshots and test fixtures)
